name: Repair lab extras
author: DEADBOARD
description: An example data mod: a new fault type (salt-water damage), a budget multimeter, one more diagnostic rule for «Where to look?», and a puzzle on the built-in voltage divider that uses the new fault.

faultTypes.name: Salt-water damage
faultTypes.description: Dried salt water between the pads: a leak you can see, and clean off with IPA.

rules.confirm: Measure the supply at {ref}'s pins and again on the board side of its joints, both + and −: a difference there is a bad joint at the input.
rules.why: When every net reads low, a resistive joint at the supply (often on the ground pin) is the usual cause.

puzzles.title: Divider · bathroom shelf
puzzles.description: This divider board sat on a bathroom shelf for a year. The output reads wrong. Look closely before you replace anything.
hints: Measure TP1 with the power on: compare with what the divider should give.
Look at the board under the camera: something has dried between two pads. A brush with IPA cleans it off.
